title: Count Symmetric Integers
summary: Given two positive integers low and high, count the number of symmetric integers within the range [low, high].
statement: Given two positive integers low and high, count the number of symmetric integers within the range [low, high]. An integer x with 2 * n digits is symmetric if the sum of its first n digits equals the sum of its last n digits.
constraints: A positive integer is symmetric when it has an even number of decimal digits.
The digit sum of its first half must equal the digit sum of its second half.
Count symmetric integers in the inclusive range low through high.
hints: Inspect every integer because the workbook domain ends at ten thousand.
Reject odd digit counts before comparing halves.
Split the decimal representation in the middle and compare the two digit sums.
The loop visits every value in the inclusive range once, and the predicate is exactly the definition.
editorial: The loop visits every value in the inclusive range once, and the predicate is exactly the definition.
